authority: Existing FTB Quests + Researchd; no separate progression state

canonical_ages.name: Stone
canonical_ages.title: Stone Settlement Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Fire, ceramics and charcoal establish a survivable TFC settlement and first copper.

canonical_ages.name: Copper
canonical_ages.title: Copper Mining Camp Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Prospecting, the copper workshop and empirical research turn survival into organized mining.

canonical_ages.name: Alloy Foundry
canonical_ages.title: Kinetic Foundry Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Water power and Create/Greate forming establish the kinetic foundry; rail preparation supports this district.

canonical_ages.name: Bronze Steam
canonical_ages.title: Bronze Steam Hall Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Bronze steam industrializes ore preparation and pumping while the kinetic foundry supplies the machine hall.

canonical_ages.name: Heavy Industry
canonical_ages.title: Heavy Industry District Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Coke, refractory, petroleum, rubber and lubrication become permanent industrial feedstocks.

canonical_ages.name: Steel Steam
canonical_ages.title: Steel and Railway Works Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Durable steel machinery and serviced freight terminals turn small hauling into repeatable bulk transport.

canonical_ages.name: Low Voltage
canonical_ages.title: Low-Voltage Grid Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Generation, metering, protected conductors, the EE converter and recoverable loads establish electric service.

canonical_ages.name: First Space
canonical_ages.title: Launch Complex Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Steel, freight, petroleum and electricity launch an expedition that returns useful cargo to Terra.

canonical_ages.name: Advanced Electric
canonical_ages.title: Advanced Electric Floor Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Returned space feedstocks become aluminum, advanced motors and a stronger Greate mechanical floor.

canonical_ages.name: Chemical and Arcane Chemistry
canonical_ages.title: Chemical Laboratory Proven
canonical_ages.contract: The refinery feeds controlled chemistry, polymers, electronics and programmable supervision.

canonical_ages.name: Stainless and Digital
canonical_ages.title: Digital Factory Proven
canonical_ages.contract: AE2 requests production and coordinates local machinery while rail and expeditions still move geographical bulk.

canonical_ages.name: High Pressure Aerospace
canonical_ages.title: Vacuum Aerospace Works Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Vacuum titanium, high pressure and large processing lines relieve repetitive production and support deep extraction.

canonical_ages.name: Cosmonautics and Deep Space
canonical_ages.title: Deep-Space Freight Yard Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Repeatable remote cargo, flight control and planetary extraction establish permanent deep-space supply.

canonical_ages.name: Nuclear Civilization
canonical_ages.title: Nuclear Complex Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Fuel preparation, coolant, output, instruments, controlled waste and recovery establish nuclear civilization.

canonical_ages.name: Extreme Industry and Eternal Starlight
canonical_ages.title: Neutron and Starlight Works Proven
canonical_ages.contract: Existing nuclear and chemical institutions reach extreme purity, neutron production and Starlight feedstocks.

canonical_ages.name: Quantum and Reality Engineering
canonical_ages.title: Quantum Systems Mastered
canonical_ages.contract: Fusion, quantum control, earned GT precision, matter replication and spatial transport scale established industry.

canonical_ages.name: Infinity and Final Ascension
canonical_ages.title: Infinity Systems Mastered
canonical_ages.contract: Infinity material, stellar power, matter engineering, deliberate esoteric convergence and restart capacity complete the civilization.

esoteric_convergence: ESO-04 is deliberately required by FRN-06 and Infinity Convergence; branch optional before final reality engineering.
